expected_level_description: You can: - ensure appropriate and proportionate governance and assurance is in place and is continuously improved, aligned to organisational and government needs - guide teams through governance and assurance processes, such as service assessments, to ensure standards are met - share the team's governance and assurance processes so stakeholders trust them to deliver value in a sustainable way
You can: - lead teams and departments in the design, implementation, administration and support of infrastructure solutions and services

You can: - design systems characterised by high levels of risk, impact, and business or technical complexity - control system design practice within an enterprise or industry architecture - influence industry-based models for the development of new technology applications - develop effective implementation and procurement strategies, consistent with business needs - ensure adherence to relevant technical strategies, policies, standards and practices
You can: - define the integration build - co-ordinate build activities across systems - understand how to undertake and support integration testing activities
You can: - anticipate and advise on future technology changes that present opportunities for the product or programme
You can: - break a problem down into its component parts to identify and diagnose root causes - troubleshoot and identify problems across different technology capabilities

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results
You can: - create, change, and remove user accounts and access rights - check access against role-based access rules
You can: - run vulnerability scans and report the results - track fixes with system owners
You can: - explain that some health software is regulated as a medical device - know who to ask when a product might be a medical device
